# PFSVC (Pakistan Freelance & Skills Verification Council)

> Independent verification body for freelancers and remote professionals in Pakistan. Not a government body. Issues a public seal after identity, skills and interview checks.

## Services
- Freelancer verification: identity and document review, skills assessment, live interview, public seal valid 12 months.
- Public seal lookup: anyone can check a badge ID. No login.
- Team and enterprise verification: 5 or more members, account manager, API access.

## Pricing (per year)
- Basic: PKR 1,499
- Professional: PKR 9,999
- Enterprise: custom quote

## Verification standards
- Government ID cross-check (CNIC or passport) and a live video liveness match.
- Sanctions and AML screening.
- Proctored, timed skills assessment with browser lock and AI-detection tools.
- Live interview with a certified senior practitioner.
- Annual re-verification. Seal is revoked if work is falsified or contracts are outsourced.

## Published figures (as stated by PFSVC)
- Acceptance rate: 22%
- Fraud denials: 1,200+
